breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the uniform load by its single resultant for an exact deflection calculation, but equivalent resultants preserve force and moment, not the full beam-deflection response.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats the load as a uniformly distributed load of 1.0 N/mm applied along the entire length, without replacing it with a resultant point load at midspan. This matches the ground truth prompt and avoids the incorrect instruction that would have used an equivalent resultant force (which does not preserve the full beam-deflection response).
